full_judgment:
This rule is directed against an order dated 16-3-76 passed by Mr. M.N.I. Khan Sessions Judges Chittagong in Criminal Misc. Case No: 489 of 1976 directing further investigation. 

 2. The facts giving rise to the Rule, in brief, are that one Mr. H.K. Chowdhury. Sub-Registrar, Hathazari p.s. filed an application before the Officer-in-charge of Hathazari p.s, praying for investigation of a theft case in his office and also for taking necessary action so that some missing documents might be recovered for public interest. It was stated in the application that as some documents from the office of the applicant were missing, he suspected accused O.P. Nos. 6, 7 and one Mohd. Hossain and Jalal Ahmed. But the police after investigation submitted charge sheet against the O.Ps. No. 4 to 7 and subsequently the accused O.Ps. No. 4 and 5. 

 5. Mr. Saadat Ali Khan, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner contends before me that as the case was under Special Power Act, the learned Sessions Judge had no jurisdiction to pass the impugned order directing re-investigation of the case. He also contends that under the Special Powers Act cognizance of a case cannot be taken accept on police report in this connection he has referred before me the case of Dost Mohammad and ors. vs. The State 29 D.L.R. page 122. Mr. Saadat Ali Khan also contends before me that the petitioner Jabal Hossain has no connection with the kabala No. 3904, he is only connected with the document No. 2100. The learned Sessions Judge wrongly mentioned in his order that both these documents were forged for the benefit of the petitioner Jabal Hossain. 

 "The Special Tribunal may on application on its own motion, direct a Police Officer to make further investigation in any case relating to an offence triable under this Act and report within such time as may be specified by it".
